meta.note: Named observance days on which continence is customarily kept or the household is occupied with vrata. Matching uses masa_index (AMANTA reckoning, 0 = Chaitra) together with paksha and tithi_idx; where a festival is normally named in purnimanta terms the amanta equivalent is given and stated in the interpretation. Recurring tithi-level bars (Ekadashi, Ashtami, Chaturdashi, Purnima, Amavasya) live in mc_prohibited.json, not here — this file only adds the named, once-a-year observances.

translations.en: Vasanta (Chaitra) Navaratri — nine nights of vrata and brahmacharya.
translations.hi: वासन्तिक (चैत्र) नवरात्रि — नौ दिन व्रत एवं ब्रह्मचर्य।

rules.interpretation: Navaratri is kept with fasting, celibacy and Devi upasana. Auspicious for new ventures in general, but conjugal union is expressly set aside for the nine nights.

translations.en: Rama Navami — the concluding day of Chaitra Navaratri, kept as a fast.
translations.hi: राम नवमी — चैत्र नवरात्रि का समापन दिवस, उपवास।

rules.interpretation: Falls on Chaitra Shukla Navami, which is also a Rikta tithi.

translations.en: Akshaya Tritiya — an abhijit-muhurta day; no restriction applies.
translations.hi: अक्षय तृतीया — स्वयंसिद्ध मुहूर्त; कोई निषेध नहीं।

rules.interpretation: Recorded with a zero penalty deliberately, so that the citation appears in the report and the user can see the day was examined and found unrestricted rather than simply unmatched.

translations.en: Naga Panchami — a vrata day of the serpent deities.
translations.hi: नाग पंचमी — नाग देवताओं का व्रत दिवस।

rules.interpretation: Observed with fasting in many households; a mild restriction rather than a bar.

translations.en: Krishna Janmashtami — a night-long fast and vigil.
translations.hi: कृष्ण जन्माष्टमी — रात्रि जागरण सहित उपवास।

rules.interpretation: Named in purnimanta reckoning as Bhadrapada Krishna Ashtami; in the amanta reckoning used here it is Shravana Krishna Ashtami. Upavasa with jagarana is kept until midnight.

translations.en: Haritalika Teej — a nirjala fast kept by married women.
translations.hi: हरितालिका तीज — विवाहित स्त्रियों का निर्जला व्रत।

rules.interpretation: A waterless fast with night vigil; physically and ritually incompatible with this samskara.

translations.en: Ganesha Chaturthi — festival and vrata day; also a Rikta tithi.
translations.hi: गणेश चतुर्थी — उत्सव एवं व्रत; रिक्ता तिथि भी।

rules.interpretation: The household is occupied with the installation and worship of Ganapati.

translations.en: Sharada (Ashwina) Navaratri — nine nights of vrata and brahmacharya.
translations.hi: शारदीय (आश्विन) नवरात्रि — नौ रात्रि व्रत एवं ब्रह्मचर्य।

rules.interpretation: The principal Navaratri. Celibacy is part of the observance for the full nine nights.

translations.en: Vijaya Dashami — a svayamsiddha muhurta; no restriction applies.
translations.hi: विजया दशमी — स्वयंसिद्ध मुहूर्त; कोई निषेध नहीं।

rules.interpretation: One of the three and a half self-accomplished muhurtas. Recorded with zero penalty so the citation is visible in the report.

translations.en: Karva Chauth — a day-long nirjala fast kept by the wife.
translations.hi: करवा चौथ — पत्नी द्वारा निर्जला व्रत।

rules.interpretation: Named in purnimanta reckoning as Kartika Krishna Chaturthi; amanta equivalent is Ashwina Krishna Chaturthi. Also a Rikta tithi.

translations.en: Dhanteras — the opening day of the Diwali sequence.
translations.hi: धनतेरस — दीपावली पर्व का प्रारम्भ।

rules.interpretation: Begins the four-day Diwali observance; the household is engaged in worship and preparation.

translations.en: Naraka Chaturdashi (Chhoti Diwali) — Parva and festival day.
translations.hi: नरक चतुर्दशी (छोटी दीपावली) — पर्व एवं उत्सव।

rules.interpretation: Compounds the standing Chaturdashi Parva bar with the Diwali observance.

translations.en: Diwali Amavasya — Lakshmi Puja night; Parva and festival.
translations.hi: दीपावली अमावस्या — लक्ष्मी पूजन; पर्व एवं उत्सव।

rules.interpretation: The Amavasya bar and the festival observance coincide.

translations.en: Bhai Dooj (Yama Dwitiya) — the closing day of Diwali.
translations.hi: भाई दूज (यम द्वितीया) — दीपावली का समापन।

rules.interpretation: A family observance; mild restriction only.

translations.en: Chhath Shashthi — a thirty-six hour nirjala fast.
translations.hi: छठ षष्ठी — छत्तीस घंटे का निर्जला व्रत।

rules.interpretation: Observed with the strictest physical discipline of the year in the regions that keep it.

translations.en: Tulsi Vivaha — Chaturmas ends and the marriage season reopens; no restriction.
translations.hi: तुलसी विवाह — चातुर्मास समाप्ति, विवाह काल आरम्भ; कोई निषेध नहीं।

rules.interpretation: Recorded with zero penalty because this date marks the *lifting* of the Chaturmas restraint — useful context in the report.

translations.en: Maha Shivaratri — night-long fast, vigil and brahmacharya.
translations.hi: महाशिवरात्रि — रात्रि जागरण, उपवास एवं ब्रह्मचर्य।

rules.interpretation: Named in purnimanta reckoning as Phalguna Krishna Chaturdashi; the amanta equivalent used here is Magha Krishna Chaturdashi. Continence for the whole night is part of the vrata.

translations.en: Holika Dahan (Phalguna Purnima) — Parva day and festival night.
translations.hi: होलिका दहन (फाल्गुन पूर्णिमा) — पर्व एवं उत्सव रात्रि।

rules.interpretation: The Purnima Parva bar coincides with the Holika observance.

translations.en: Holi (Dhulandi) — the day after Holika Dahan.
translations.hi: होली (धुलण्डी) — होलिका दहन के अगले दिन।

rules.interpretation: A public festival day; mild restriction only.

translations.en: Sankashti Chaturthi — a monthly Ganapati fast broken at moonrise.
translations.hi: संकष्टी चतुर्थी — मासिक गणपति व्रत, चन्द्रोदय पर पारण।

rules.interpretation: Recurs every month. Small penalty; the underlying Rikta bar is carried by the tithi table.

translations.en: Pradosh Vrata — the twice-monthly Shiva fast at twilight.
translations.hi: प्रदोष व्रत — मास में दो बार सायंकालीन शिव व्रत।

rules.interpretation: Observed in the twilight window only; a small penalty reflects that the restriction is partial.
